Let P, d ∈ ℕ with d + 1 < P, n := d + 1, and let ISP be the integer slice property of sibling slice_limit. Then LD_{P,d}: there is η₀ > 0 such that for every C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with ∂C = 0 and ISP(C), every Borel μ finite on compacts with μ(W) = M_W(C) for open W, and every μ-a.e. strongly measurable ξ with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ-a.e. and C(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ, liminf_{r↓0} μ(B_r(x))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≥ η₀ for μ-a.e. x (ω_n = unitBallVolume n).

subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent V5 and T3. Uses (SL) = sibling slicing and (REP) of sibling foundations; (Isor) only for m := d − 1 (d ≥ 1, m + 1 = d < P). Constants: if n ≥ 2 let c be the (Isor) constant for (P, n − 2) and κ(η) := c(2c)^{1/(n−1)}(2n)^{n/(n−1)}(ηω_n)^{1/(n−1)}; κ := 0 if n = 1; choose η₀ ∈ (0, 1/4) with κ(η₀) ≤ 1/2 and 4cnη₀ω_n ≤ 1.
0. Cone inequality: if X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), M(X) < ∞, ∂X = 0, spt X ⊆ B̄_ϱ(x₀), then |X(ω)| ≤ ϱM(X)‖dω‖_∞. Indeed the radial homotopy operator K (dK + Kd = id on forms of degree ≥ 1, |Kγ(x)| ≤ |x − x₀|‖γ‖_∞) and a cut-off ζ = 1 near spt X give X(ω) = X(ζKdω) by (VO), and (REP) bounds this by ϱM(X)‖dω‖_∞.
1. Θ(x) := liminf_r μ(B_r(x))/(ω_nrⁿ) is Borel (lower semicontinuity in x, left continuity in r). By inner regularity it suffices to show μ(K') = 0 for compact K' ⊆ {Θ < η₀}. Fix ε₀ > 0 and W := {dist(·, K') < ε₀}.
2. For x₁ ∈ K' and small δ choose s < δ with F(s) := μ(B_s(x₁)) < η₀ω_nsⁿ. Since ∫_0^s(F^{1/n})' ≤ F(s)^{1/n}, a positive-measure set of ρ ∈ (0, s) has (F^{1/n})'(ρ) ≤ 2(η₀ω_n)^{1/n}; choose such ρ with μ(∂B_ρ(x₁)) = 0 and the ISP conclusion valid for f := |· − x₁| and the representations (μ, ξ), (0, 0).
3. (SL) gives Z := ∂(C⌞B_ρ(x₁)), IM by ISP, supported in ∂B_ρ(x₁), with M(Z) ≤ F'(ρ) ≤ 2nη₀ω_ns^{n−1} and, for n ≥ 2, M(Z)^{n/(n−1)} ≤ (2n)^{n/(n−1)}(η₀ω_n)^{1/(n−1)}F(ρ).
4. If n ≥ 2, (Isor) gives an IM S with ∂S = Z, M(S) ≤ κ(η₀)μ(B_ρ(x₁)) and spt S ⊆ B̄_{(1+3√P)δ}(x₁). If n = 1, M(Z) < 1 forces Z = 0 ((MR) with counting measure H⁰) and S := 0.
5. The closed balls of steps 2–4 form a fine family on K'; Besicovitch (exists_disjoint_closedBall_covering_ae) gives disjoint B_i ⊆ W with μ(K' ∖ ⋃B_i) = 0. The cycles X_i := S_i − C⌞B_i have M(X_i) ≤ (1 + κ)μ(B_i) and support in B̄_{(1+3√P)δ}(x_i), so by step 0 C_δ := C⌞(ℝ^P ∖ ⋃B_i) + ΣS_i satisfies |C_δ(ω) − C(ω)| ≤ (1+3√P)δ(1+κ)μ(W)‖dω‖_∞.
6. As δ ↓ 0, C_δ ⇀ C, so μ(W) = M_W(C) ≤ liminf M_W(C_δ) ≤ μ(W ∖ K') + κμ(W) ≤ μ(W ∖ K') + μ(W)/2. Hence μ(K') ≤ μ(W ∖ K') → 0 as ε₀ ↓ 0. ∎
Note: the accepted cbrld_* declarations (e.g. cbrld_exists_good_slice_radius, cbrld_cycle_eval_le_radius_mul_mass) cover steps 0–6 except the in-range filling with (Isor).
proof_key_steps: Covering and lower semicontinuity give μ(K′) = 0.

audit.reason: The proof supplies the uniform positive constant through good radii, in-range fillings, the cone estimate, disjoint covering and lower semicontinuity. The n=1 argument correctly uses the integer mass gap instead of a positive-dimensional filling.
